title: White Knuckle Watersports
specs: Yamaha Jet Skis seat up to three people.
Excursions often feature bottlenose dolphin sightings.
Excursion destinations include Caladesi Island (ranked as top US beach), Honeymoon Island, and Hurricane Pass.
Tours cover up to 40 miles round trip and visit exclusive islands only accessible by boat.
You must be at least 16 years old to ride on your own jet ski.
Riders under 18 must have a guardian over 18 to sign for them.
Valid Driver’s License, State Issued ID, or Passport required.
